picks.name: Malik Willis
picks.note: Averaging 20+ fantasy points over his last 3 games despite MIA's slow pace; 100+ rushing yards and 2 rushing TDs in that stretch; DET is 29th in dropback EPA and 31st in schedule-adjusted points vs. QBs; 7-pt home underdogs should mean a pass-heavy approach; stack with Dulcich

picks.name: Shedeur Sanders
picks.note: First start of the season in a dream matchup; NOS is 23rd in dropback EPA with one of the lowest pressure rates; has shown he'll throw downfield when given time and has better weapons now; indoors in a fast-paced game means more plays; stack with Boston/Concepcion

picks.name: Brock Purdy
picks.note: Terrific efficiency plus 3.2 fantasy points per game on the ground; Evans and Samuel both out makes the stack easier (McCaffrey and/or Kittle); 31-pt team total vs. LVR, who are quickly becoming one of the worst defenses in football; one of two QBs projected for double-digit ownership

picks.name: Drew Lock
picks.note: Would be Core over Sanders if 100% healthy, but a right elbow injury has limited his throwing in recent weeks; elite weapons and an elite matchup vs. ARI (31st in dropback EPA, 29th in schedule-adjusted points vs. QBs); min salary on DK makes him a tournament play even with the injury

picks.name: Dak Prescott
picks.note: DAL's bad defense has forced him to air it out, which has helped his production, and his expected fantasy points say he has left points on the field; dome matchup vs. IND (24th in schedule-adjusted points vs. QBs); pairs with Lamb or Pickens

picks.name: Patrick Mahomes
picks.note: Some middling outings but also 28, 32 and 23-point games; KC is 3rd in pass rate over expectation; NYJ are 28th in dropback EPA; most lineups will feature a cheap QB, so don't forget him in tournament builds

picks.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
picks.note: Scored 28 fantasy points vs. MIN even after losing pass-protection snaps to Vaki; MIA is bottom 12 in run EPA and schedule-adjusted points vs. RBs; real chance at 25 touches; easy to fit with all the value at QB, WR and TE

picks.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
picks.note: The chalk that busted last week despite 22 touches, as NEP fell behind early and the TDs went to Maye; Henderson still out; should see 20+ touches vs. GB (23rd in schedule-adjusted points vs. RBs); could be shied away from after a middling game

picks.name: Kenneth Walker III
picks.note: Leads the NFL in rushing yards over expectation and has every carry inside the 5; 12% target share; averaging 23 fantasy points per game, behind only Gibbs; NYJ are 8th in run EPA, which doesn't worry me

picks.name: Christian McCaffrey
picks.note: Would be Core without the hamstring concern; expected to play, but hamstrings are tricky and he played 50% of snaps last week; LVR are 23rd in run EPA and 24th in schedule-adjusted points vs. RBs; massive team total; projected for the most RB ownership; stack with Purdy

picks.name: Jonah Coleman
picks.note: Took over the feature role with Harvey out: 15 touches to 7 for Dobbins, 90% of second-half snaps and a TD; role could grow in a better matchup; CAR is 25th in run EPA and 29th in schedule-adjusted points vs. RBs

picks.name: Chuba Hubbard
picks.note: 92% of snaps and 29 touches last week with little competition for touches; can't expect that volume every week, but a struggling Young could push CAR run-heavy vs. DEN, who are 26th in run EPA

picks.name: Javonte Williams
picks.note: Clear path to 20+ touches vs. IND (29th in run EPA, 30th in schedule-adjusted points vs. RBs); expecting DAL to score, so exposure to the passing game or Williams in every lineup; could move up a tier by Sunday

picks.name: Devin Singletary
picks.note: Skattebo doubtful and Tracy on IR; expected to start with Desrosiers as the backup; no longer as explosive but in line for a hefty workload vs. PHI (31st in run EPA); extremely cheap

picks.name: Puka Nacua
picks.note: Only Core tag at WR; 34% target share and 39% air yards share, with target share up to 41% in games Adams has missed; 26.5-pt team total vs. WAS (26th in dropback EPA, 21st in schedule-adjusted points vs. WRs); top play of the expensive options

picks.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
picks.note: Arguably the best receiver in football vs. a defense that is 31st in dropback EPA; the concern is Lock's elbow and SEA leaning on the run as big favorites, though they may want to make a statement after losing to CHI

picks.name: CeeDee Lamb
picks.note: One of the most concentrated target trees in the NFL on a defense that gives up points in bunches; better usage and production than Pickens, so a slight preference; not double stacking with Dak; viable vs. IND

picks.name: George Pickens
picks.note: Squeaky-wheel narrative: Jones and Schottenheimer both said he needs more involvement; rarely has big games with Lamb; viable vs. IND

picks.name: Adonai Mitchell
picks.note: Garrett Wilson ruled out, making him a top target for Geno Smith; 7-142-1 vs. LVR last week; strong value vs. KC; likely more owned than Cooper

picks.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
picks.note: Garrett Wilson ruled out; no catches last week but ran more routes than Mitchell and has flashed upside; strong value vs. KC; expected to be significantly less owned than Mitchell

picks.name: KC Concepcion
picks.note: Low aDOT and the higher floor of the Browns' value WRs; part of the Sanders stack in an exploitable indoor matchup vs. NOS

picks.name: Denzel Boston
picks.note: Much higher target share and more upside than Concepcion; part of the Sanders stack in an exploitable indoor matchup vs. NOS

picks.name: Matthew Golden
picks.note: Always viable in tournaments; one of Golden and Watson always seems to have a big game, and sometimes both do; NEP are 21st in schedule-adjusted points vs. WRs; figure out who Christian Gonzalez shadows and the other is a standout

picks.name: Christian Watson
picks.note: Always viable in tournaments; one of Watson and Golden always seems to have a big game, and sometimes both do; NEP are 21st in schedule-adjusted points vs. WRs; figure out who Christian Gonzalez shadows and the other is a standout

picks.name: Makai Lemon
picks.note: WR1 for PHI with DeVonta Smith and Wicks out; 13-of-17 targets for 134 yards and a TD over the last 2 games; NYG are 7th in schedule-adjusted points vs. WRs, but he's affordable with volume; Joe Milton is a question mark

picks.name: Antonio Williams
picks.note: McLaurin on IR; led the team in routes last week and caught 5-of-7 targets for 54 yards; not a great matchup vs. LAR, but a strong value

picks.name: Efton Chism III
picks.note: 88% of snaps and a 25% target share with Brown and Doubs out last week; Hollins could return but likely limited; could be the WR1 at a very cheap price vs. GB

picks.name: Malik Washington
picks.note: 25% target share and 28% air yards share; not my favorite pairing with Willis, but a strong value; DET are 27th in schedule-adjusted points vs. WRs

picks.name: Greg Dulcich
picks.note: Could be the highest-owned TE, but he has a lot in his favor: 5+ targets in each of the last 3 games and DET are dead last in fantasy points allowed to TEs; game script should mean plenty of dropbacks for Willis; stack with Willis

picks.name: George Kittle
picks.note: Evans and Samuel out and CMC dealing with a hamstring injury; 22% target share and 22% air yards share in one of the best offenses in the NFL; LVR are 25th in dropback EPA and 27th in schedule-adjusted points vs. TEs; projected for 25% ownership; stack with Purdy

picks.name: Saints
picks.note: Off a bye and at home vs. a turnover-prone QB; if the offense performs better they should build a lead, and with 35+ dropbacks for Sanders I expect sacks and mistakes; cheap on both sites and among the highest pOWN

picks.name: Seahawks
picks.note: Home favorites vs. the lowly ARI; Minshew's good game last week was garbage time vs. DAL, and SEA is a different story; prefer the defense over their skill players this week

picks.name: Chargers
picks.note: Winless but still a top-10 defense, with an offense that can't score or help it out; HOU hasn't been world-beating; tournament pivot if you won't eat the Saints chalk, with game-script risk
